noun_definition: Delay refers to the lag experienced when attempting to access a thread after clicking the reply notification, following the deletion of the parent message while offline.
accessing thread refers to the action of entering a conversation thread in a chat application after receiving a reply notification.

Deleting parent message refers to the action of removing the original message to which a reply was made while the user is offline, which subsequently affects the access to the reply thread when the user comes back online.
Offline refers to the state of being disconnected from the internet, during which the user deletes a parent message in a chat.
